title: str2num
summary: Convert text containing numeric matrix literals to a numeric array.

gpu_support.notes: No GPU kernel is registered for this compatibility builtin; GPU-resident inputs are gathered to host memory before evaluation.

fusion.notes: Not eligible for fusion; this builtin materializes host text or logical results.

description: [x, tf] = str2num(text) - Convert text containing numeric matrix literals to a numeric array.
behaviors: Convert text containing numeric matrix literals to a numeric array.
Parses bracketed numeric matrix text with whitespace, comma, and semicolon separators.
When a second output is requested, returns a logical success flag instead of throwing for malformed numeric text.
examples: [x,tf] = str2num("[1 2; 3 4]") returns a 2-by-2 numeric matrix and true.
